name: page1_by_amount
source: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount = 30 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 0, 2

name: page2_by_amount
source: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount = 30 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 2, 2

name: city_nulls
source: SELECT id, city FROM orders ORDER BY city DESC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0

name: customers_ci
source: SELECT id, customer FROM orders WHERE customer = 'ALICE' ORDER BY customer

name: order_day
source: SELECT id, DATE(created_at) AS day, CONVERT_TZ(created_at, '+08:00', '+00:00') AS utc FROM orders ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 4

name: amounts
source: SELECT id, amount FROM orders ORDER BY id

name: hand_written_day
source: SELECT id, DATE(created_at) AS day FROM orders ORDER BY id LIMIT 3
target: SELECT id, DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS day FROM orders ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0
